title: MoganColBERT-TR: A Late-Interaction Multi-Vector Retrieval Model for Turkish
abstract: arXiv:2608.26344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We previously reported a ModernBERT encoder trained from scratch for Turkish (MoganBERT-TR) and a single-vector embedding model built on top of it (MoganBERT-embed). This work introduces the third model in that lineage: MoganColBERT-TR, a multi-vector retrieval model that, instead of compressing a query or a document into a single vector, represents it at the token level through a 768->128 projection and scores it with MaxSim late interaction. The model is not trained from scratch: the embedding model's encoder is taken as the starting point and adapted to the ColBERT objective with a single-epoch distillation phase. Training data is produced from two sources - title-to-passage pairs carved out of our own pretraining corpus in the character domain and at sentence boundaries, and two Turkish question-based retrieval sets - and is distilled from the soft scores of a cross-encoder teacher (bge-reranker-v2-m3) over one positive and seven min

translated_title: MoganColBERT-TR：面向土耳其语的晚期交互多向量检索模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26344v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们先前报告了从零开始训练的土耳其语ModernBERT编码器（MoganBERT-TR）以及在其基础上构建的单向量嵌入模型（MoganBERT-embed）。这项工作介绍了该系列中的第三个模型：MoganColBERT-TR，一个多向量检索模型，它不是将查询或文档压缩为单个向量，而是通过768->128投影在词元级别表示它，并使用MaxSim晚期交互进行评分。该模型并非从零开始训练：嵌入模型的编码器被用作起点，并通过单周期蒸馏阶段适应ColBERT目标。训练数据来自两个来源——从我们自己的预训练语料库中在字符域和句子边界处切出的标题-段落对，以及两个基于土耳其语问题的检索集——并从一个交叉编码器教师模型（bge-reranker-v2-m3）对一个正例和七个负例的软分数中蒸馏而来。
tldr: 该论文提出了MoganColBERT-TR，一种基于晚期交互的多向量检索模型，通过从嵌入模型微调并利用交叉编码器蒸馏，实现了土耳其语的高效词元级检索。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MoganColBERT-TR, a late-interaction multi-vector retrieval model fine-tuned from an embedding model with cross-encoder distillation for efficient token-level Turkish retrieval.
